title: Tier Pressure
subtitle: Every weapon, item and drop spot in Fortnite, ranked
version_note: Chapter 7 Season 4 (Override), Fortnitemares update v42.30. Rankings as of 12 October 2026.
description: An unofficial Fortnite fan book ranking every weapon, item, Sprite, Override and drop spot in Battle Royale right now.
glossary_blurb: Every Word Watch word in this book, from A to Z. Try dropping three of them into conversation this week. Bonus points for using one in the lobby.
